proposal.title: Campaign timeline — COMDEX 1979 campaign and presentation
proposal.reason: Convert this campaign to an independent dated timeline object. Dates are resolved from its execution process without changing precision. Preserve all existing event/subprocess ownership; marketing-step reference_id is absent throughout. Consolidate presentations, campaign material and useful claim-policy requirements into narrated steps; remove historical acceptance labels and duplicate import fragments. Product-owned launch links remain authoritative and validated through the explicit transitional execution mapping.

before.title: COMDEX 1979 campaign and presentation
before.objective: Communicate the launch, qualify demonstrations and coordinate follow-up described by the source campaign.
message: messages / campaign: More room to work. More freedom to choose.
messages / aurelia plus: Your existing software. Less waiting.
messages / abacus 2: Calculate once. Chart it. Print the documents.
claim_policy: Legacy acceptance wording (not new confirmation) / status: Accepted alternative-history campaign; demonstrations require qualification, not claimed measured results
partner policy / bpi: Independent branding, management, licences and support. The head of BPI speaks immediately after Abacus and joins the partner segment.
partner policy / peripherals: Demonstrate only individually qualified configurations. Invitations and targets are not agreements or shipments.

partner policy / manufacturers: Published interfaces and kit permit independent Aurelia-class implementations; support and certification optional. Native hardware adapters are valid; FlexiBUS and Logix video are separate profiles. Proper application/OS/firmware licences remain necessary.
commercial policy / new buyers: Clearly identify the hardware, required software and printing configuration; distinguish BPI licences and specialist setup.
commercial policy / existing owners: New capabilities for the computer you already own. Publish configuration requirements and explain workloads that benefit from Aurelia+.

commercial policy / manufacturers: Published specifications/self-tests, physical compatibility kits, optional bounded assistance and configuration-specific certification; no exclusive partnership required.
commercial policy / suppliers: Interoperability sessions and verified directory listings; document production supplies a concrete printer use case.
commercial policy / promotion: Promote training, demonstration access and implementation help.
strategy: Logix focuses new hardware development and promotion on Aurelia+ while enabling independent Aurelia-class clones and maintaining installed-base support; no immediate withdrawal date.
disclosure / architecture reveal: 1980-05-19
disclosure / permitted: Native binary compatibility will change; established C practices reduce migration work; a planned optional Z80 path supports qualified legacy code.
disclosure / withheld: No future product/processor/OS names, word size, architecture, future-target compiler output, binaries or revealing demonstrations before NCC 1980.

stage.label: opening
stage.description: Adam: growing businesses need more capacity, less waiting and compatible choices.

stage.label: aurelia_plus_speed
stage.description: Identical live calculated shaded-cube animation on Aurelia and Aurelia+, followed by identical Abacus recalculation and chart generation; present measured results.

stage.label: abacus_2
stage.description: Chart employee pay values; link fields to a payslip layout; preview employees and print the entire batch.

stage.label: bpi
stage.description: The head of independent BPI demonstrates BPI Payroll as the source of calculated values, documented file exchange and reconciled totals.

stage.label: pulse
stage.description: Demonstrate a focused information-management task using tested, implemented capabilities; no implied live cross-application integration.

stage.label: manufacturers
stage.description: Introduce the Compatibility Kit, reference adapters and diagnostics. Show an independent application implementation only after qualification; otherwise show clearly labelled engineering work.

stage.label: partners
stage.description: BPI leadership joins participating peripheral/computer suppliers. Name products and distinguish shipping, qualified and prototype status.

stage.label: availability
stage.description: Purchasing, existing-Aurelia upgrades, ongoing support and independent manufacturer participation; new hardware focus on Aurelia+.

stage.label: Benchmark system
stage.description: Aurelia

stage.label: Benchmark system
stage.description: Aurelia+

stage.label: speed demonstration / segment minutes / shaded cube
speed demonstration / workload
stage.description: Calculate rotation, project vertices, determine visible faces, calculate shading and draw a fixed sequence of cube rotations live. No prerecorded animation or precomputed frames.

stage.label: speed demonstration / controls / 0
stage.description: Same executable and inputs on both machines, compatible with both

stage.label: speed demonstration / controls / 1
stage.description: Same resolution, shading method, rendering settings and equivalent qualified display configurations; disclose unavoidable differences

stage.label: speed demonstration / controls / 2
stage.description: Visible start countdown, elapsed time and completed-frame count

stage.label: speed demonstration / controls / 3
stage.description: Fixed frame/rotation sequence completes the same amount of work; no silent frame skipping or quality reduction

stage.label: speed demonstration / controls / 4
stage.description: Use a workload that fits both machines; demonstrate additional capacity separately

stage.label: speed demonstration / controls / 5
stage.description: Both machines must finish correctly; publish results only after measurement

stage.label: speed demonstration / business comparison
stage.description: Same Abacus 2.0 executable, worksheet values/formulas, calculation settings and chart workload. Compare recalculation and chart-generation time; exclude physical printer time.

stage.label: speed demonstration / interpretation
stage.description: Animation measures the combined calculation/display path, not pure CPU performance. The catalog clocks are 4 and 6 MHz, but no 1.5x or other application speedup is promised.

stage.label: abacus demonstration / headline features / 0
stage.description: Charts

stage.label: abacus demonstration / headline features / 1
stage.description: Document layouts populated by spreadsheet field values

stage.label: abacus demonstration / chart scope
stage.description: Use the catalogued text-mode vertical or horizontal bar charts; do not imply unimplemented graphical chart types.

stage.label: abacus demonstration / data
stage.description: Fictitious employees with names, departments, pay components, deductions and precalculated net pay; one row per employee.

stage.label: abacus demonstration / steps / 0
stage.description: Inspect precalculated values and reconcile totals

stage.label: abacus demonstration / steps / 1
stage.description: Show a payroll-cost bar chart by department

stage.label: abacus demonstration / steps / 2
stage.description: Open one reusable payslip layout and identify linked spreadsheet fields

stage.label: abacus demonstration / steps / 3
stage.description: Preview different employees to show field substitution

stage.label: abacus demonstration / steps / 4
stage.description: Print one complete payslip per employee from the same layout

stage.label: abacus demonstration / acceptance / 0
stage.description: Validate field mapping, missing values, numeric formatting and rounding

stage.label: abacus demonstration / acceptance / 1
stage.description: Validate pagination and ensure every selected employee prints exactly once with the correct values

stage.label: abacus demonstration / acceptance / 2
stage.description: Validate save/reopen and preserve spreadsheet/document contents

stage.label: abacus demonstration / acceptance / 3
stage.description: Reconcile BPI-exported values with source totals through documented versioned disk-file exchange

stage.label: abacus demonstration / boundary
stage.description: Abacus charts, formats and prints supplied calculations. Payroll law/rules, statutory deductions and updates belong to the payroll application or properly maintained worksheet. No direct ledger write-back or live database link.

stage.label: abacus demonstration / sparse storage
stage.description: Supporting implementation advantage for useful workloads, not a permanently exclusive general technique.

stage.label: abacus demonstration / existing owners
stage.description: Promote Abacus 2.0 on both Aurelia and Aurelia+ in supported configurations. Do not imply a new computer is required.
